propositions: The context character bound of 24,000 chars is too low; tickets with 34,282 and 41,595 chars cannot complete close without force-close because correct merged work lacks a path to closed state.
The failure path for step-budget exhaustion incorrectly reports 'install the agents extra' as a remedy when the completion verifier actually ran and consumed budget, not a missing dependency.

The bounds are mutually incoherent: _MAX_TOTAL_CRITERIA_CHARS (32,000) exceeds _MAX_CONTEXT_CHARS (24,000) despite criteria being a subset of context, allowing criteria sets to pass all bounds then fail on context.

Compaction approaches to fit over-cap contexts are unsafe for signing gates: dropping comment history silently deletes whole child tickets and their unmet criteria on epics, creating invisible false-pass vectors.
The remedy selection logic uses exception type rather than cause, so recovery failures from any stage get blamed as missing dependencies instead of their actual measured cause.
